title: 2110 Prairie against its photographs: broader bow windows, truer loggia
items: 2110 Prairie's bow now has the broad windows its photographs show, three a storey on narrow stone piers, each parlour window with a transom light; its five-arched loggia is narrowed to the photographs' width, the gable's slit window and carved panel sit lower as both photographs place them, carved corbels stand under the gable's corners, and the south chimney rises higher.
